name: Gotharman LD3 (Little deFormer 3) and LD3 MkII PolyTouch
description: Gotharman LD3 (Little deFormer 3) and LD3 MkII PolyTouch: every parameter its manual lists as controllable by CC, a part's on that part's channel.

sources.title: LD3 MkII PolyTouch user manual 15.93
sources.notes: The list of parameters controllable by CC (PDF pages 617 - 619), read by tools/profiles/gotharman/read-gotharman-manual.mjs from LD3_MKII_PT_USER_MANUAL_15_93.pdf (sha256 b3cb3872a21b83aa0e81fe0108f9ebfa1bf8f0ffee289a3e8f94f71c85bb72e6), https://gotharman.dk/onewebmedia/LD3%20MKII%20PT%20USER%20MANUAL%2015_93.pdf, linked from https://gotharman.dk/ld3_manual. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/gotharman/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/gotharman/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's list of parameters controllable by CC, sent 0 - 127 (the manual gives no ranges): a part's on the variable partChannel, "MIDI channel are equal to part number", the instrument's on the channel variable, its global channel. The instrument answers only with its MIDI In mode set to Omni, Omni Thru, Multi-Timbral or Multi-Timbral/Thru and PccIN (Parameter CC Input) on; CClayr says whether the selected morph layer or both are set. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The LD3 MkI manual (14.19) prints the same list.
